title: Bank of America Merrill Lynch Talk Positives on Danaher Corp., "Investors Will Be Pleased"
description: "Bank of America Merrill Lynch (NYSE:BAC) analysts John G. Inch and Karen K. Lau wrote in a research note Thursday that ""...investors will be pleased with Danaher's [NYSE:DHR] solid beat on the quarter.    ""While the sequential guidance is important, we expect the company to continue to attempt to keep expectations down. Therefore, we expect the market will be inclined to look through any potentially subdued guidance given what appears to be building Danaher operating momentum and rebounding Medical results.""    ""Danaher reported 3Q10 operating earnings of 60 cents which is comparable to our 55 cent forecast that matched the 55 cent consensus estimate (guidance 50- 55 cents). Core revenue growth of 12.5% matched our 12.4% estimate. Overall revenues of $3.19bn slightly exceeded our $3.12bn estimate. As expected, the quarter contained various adjustments for the formation of the Tools joint venture with Cooper Industries,"" the analysts concluded."

Therefore, we expect the market will be inclined to look through any potentially subdued guidance,. Given what appears to be building Danaher operating momentum and rebounding medical results. Danaher reported third quarter 2010 operating earnings of $0.60,. Which is comparable to our $0.55 forecast that matched the $0.55 consensus estimates. Guidance was $0.50 to $0.55. Core revenue growth of 12.5% matched our 12.4% estimate. Overall revenues of $3.19 billion slightly exceeded our $3.12 billion estimate. As expected, the quarter contained various adjustments for the formation of the tools joint venture with Cooper Industries. For more news and market analysis, please subscribe to our YouTube channel. This is the Financial News Network. I'm Sarah Hashim-Warris.
